## Overview

ThreatTree’s Help Center documents forests containing data-flow diagrams and AND/OR attack trees, including links from attack steps to targeted DFD nodes. It describes likelihood-by-impact scoring, a ranked risk register, mitigations and treatment fields, control mappings, collaboration, audit logs, exports, architecture imports, and external ticketing integrations.

## Limits

The documentation is first-party. No acceptance test or cross-tool round-trip test was performed, and no official public source repository was identified in the research pass. Pricing is intentionally retained only as dated RPT-0003 evidence.
